Independent joins and grouped reports

Unit 2 · Week 5 · Lesson 4 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open a fresh working copy of database-project.sqlite in a school-approved SQLite tool. Keep sql-starter.sqlite unchanged. The project edition adds Equipment.ReplacementCost. Review database-project-setup.sql and use database-project-workbook.md, database-project-answers.md and database-project-reports.sql. Use fictional data and public explained answers. No cloud account is required. These 55-minute timings are flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Independent joins and grouped reports

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Use the separate database-project.sqlite edition of the equipment desk. ReplacementCost contains fictional whole-dollar teaching estimates, not current prices. Activities are ungraded. This week practices joins and summaries; controlled changes follow in Week 6. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

2. The report requirement comes first

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Recall and prediction

Loan provides LoanID, DueDate and Returned; Borrower provides BorrowerLabel; Equipment provides EquipmentID and CategoryID; Category provides CategoryName. Four tables are needed. Use matching keys, filter Returned=0 and sort oldest due date first, then LoanID. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

3. A summary for each category

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked example

GROUP BY lists both displayed non-aggregate category fields. This inner join summarises categories having matching items. A category with no Equipment rows is absent. Source rows represent items, not loan events. Expected C01 Imaging 2 1050; C02 Support 1 80; C03 Audio 2 270. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

4. The complete category summary

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Teacher model with predictions

Cross-check 2+1+2=5 items and 1050+80+270=1400 dollars. These totals match the ungrouped inventory report. The input is Category joined to Equipment, not Loan. This result does not establish the count of active loans. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

5. Checks for joined and summary reports

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Ask partners to explain the row meaning before checking totals. A plausible result can use the wrong input grain. Acceptance criteria are conditions you can check against requirements. These are ungraded self-review checks; no assessment score or tracking is added. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

6. Two reports to build independently

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application

Question 2: SELECT l.LoanID, b.BorrowerLabel, e.EquipmentID, c.CategoryName, l.DueDate FROM Loan AS l INNER JOIN Borrower AS b ON l.BorrowerID=b.BorrowerID INNER JOIN Equipment AS e ON l.EquipmentID=e.EquipmentID INNER JOIN Category AS c ON e.CategoryID=c.CategoryID WHERE l.Returned=0 ORDER BY l.DueDate,l.LoanID; rows L001 Learner A E01 Imaging 2026-04-06; L006 Learner D E05 Audio 2026-04-07; L002 Learner B E02 Support 2026-04-08; L004 Learner C E04 Imaging 2026-04-10. Question 4 uses the category summary shown. Inspect creation SQL to identify PK, FK, NOT NULL and CHECK; creating/testing it and controlled data changes are taught next week. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

7. A category with no items

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Misconception check with reasons

No. INNER JOIN supplies no input rows for that category, so it has no group in this query. Reporting all categories with zero counts needs a different query design. Do not confuse this with an ungrouped aggregate over empty input, which produces one summary row. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.

8. A corrected report to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Reflection and a fresh example

Examples: two items with the same description expose description matching; a repeated loan for one item exposes duplicated inventory costs; an unused parent exposes inner-join omission. Record expected and actual results for self-review. Week 6 continues creation/constraints and controlled INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE practice with recovery. Teaching source: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#database-solution.
